tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250las gzhung gzhan dang mi sbrel skabs tshogs mchod ni/1$0000300

thabs shes kyi rdzas rnams bdud rtsis bsang gtor byas nas/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal thugs ka nas: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros tshogs rdzas kyi: dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus: slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs: zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang mchog: drag po e yi gzhal yas nas: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yab yum sprul 'khor bcas pa rnams: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros la/ dang po ni/ bza' dang bca' dang btung ba'i tshogs: ma tshang med pa'i 'dod yon rdzas: kha dog dri ro bcud ldan pa'i: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas kun tu dgyes par mdzod: oṃ kro dha rā dza ya mān+ta ka ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa skong bshags ni/ hūm̐: 'dod yon tshogs kyi longs spyod dang: srid zhi'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis: khro rgyal 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bdag cag mi dge 'khrul pa'i blos: bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams pa yis: khyod kyi thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol zhing bshags so tshangs par gsol: yig brgya brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ liṅga bcas la/ e/ mthing nag 'bar ba'i lcags khang du// nṛ tri dgra bgegs gzugs rten la// bla srog ā kar+ṣā ya dzaḥkhug chings sdoms la myos su chugs// hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes la: glo bur bdag lta'i zhing bcu'i dgra: ye shes rno dbal mtshon cha yis: skye med chos sku'i klong du bsgral: nṛ tri sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad: stob pa ni/ hūm̐: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: srid gsum zhing kun gang ba'i longs spyod 'di:

sku gsum rol pa khrag 'thung zhal du bstab: khams gsum yongs grol dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti pū dza ho: las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag byas thabs shes kyi rdzas gnyis bsnol mar stob cing*/ hoḥ lha dang bram ze gtsang ma za/ khyi phag la sogs mi gtsang za// de dag grol bar mi 'gyur te// gnyis 'dzin spangs na grol gyis rol// ces drang*/ slob dpon gyis/ e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba'i rdzas// thabs kyis spyad na grol ba'i rgyu// de phyir bdag ni 'dod yon spyod// a la la hoḥ 'dus pa gzhan rnams la'ang drang zhing 'dod pa lnga ldan du rol/ lhag ma bsdus la kha phru gdab cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: sa 'dod yon lnga ldan du byas la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje yi: bka' nyan lhag mar dbang ba'i 'khor: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging laṅka: 'bar ma ma sring sha za dang: lha srin sde brgyad dregs par bcas: kun kyang mi bsrun gdug pa can: sha la dga' zhing khrag la mos: stong gsum bskor zhing dur khrod nyul: dam tshig can gyi las mkhan mdzad: dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed ma byed: 'dir byon 'dod yon lhag gtor bzhes: dgra bgegs zhing bcu cham la phob: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes phyi rol du dor/ thugs dam bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas drag po'i skur: gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i lha: bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: thugs dam bskul lo phrin las mdzod: chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas// zla gsang rgyud sde gsungs pa'i tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de 'og 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis// rgyud don man ngag la bsdebs tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i:

bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de 'og shān+tiṃ gar+bha yis// mu stegs ngan pa tshar bcad tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de 'og pad 'byung bai ro yis// 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de 'og skal ldan chos bdag gis// zab gter gsang rgya bkrol ba'i tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: da lta sngags 'chang bdag cag gis// 'jam dpal bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i tshe// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon dam rdzas gtor ma longs: khas blangs ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ gtor ma'i bshal chu bdud rtsir spar te/ hūm̐: bod yul skyong bar mdzad pa mo: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: 'dir byon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhes: sngon tshe pad+ma thod phreng gi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ltar: gangs can ljongs 'dir dus 'khrugs dang: mi mthun nad mug kun zhi nas: rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa dang: theg mchog bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: pañtsa a mṛta ba liṃ ta khā hi: rta bro ni/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu dmigs bya mnan par bsam la/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten gzhal yas na: skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun: khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sprul pa'i khro bos snang srid gang: thabs mchog rkang g.yas bro brdungs pas: pho sri thams cad g.yas su gnan: shes rab g.yon gyis bro brdungs pas:

mo sri thams cad g.yon du gnan: gnyis su med par bro brdungs pas: chung sri dam sri dbyings su gnan: drag po'i gar gyis bro brdungs pas: dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog: phrin las rnam bzhi'i bro brdungs pas: las bzhi myur du 'grub par shog: sarba sha trūṃ a mu ka mā ra ya rbad nan: shān+tiṃ: puṣ+ṭiṃ: wā shaṃ: mā ra ya rbad: dngos grub blang ba ni/ hoḥ 'jam dpal dpa' bo he ru ka /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam bcas pa'i// phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab// thun mong tshe dpal nus stobs sogs// srid zhi'i phun tshogs phrin las bzhi// gang bsam 'bad med grub par mdzod// don dam mi dmigs bde ba che// sku gsum bdag nyid gdod ma'i mgon// tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur nas// gzhan don ris med 'grub par gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ slar mchod pa ni/ phyi nang nyer spyod sman gtor rak+tar bcas pas mchod cing bstod de/ bshags pa ni/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// zhes dang yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla'o// dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rten yod na de la bstim/ med na ye shes pa rnams/ hūm̐: rang rig ye nas 'jam dpal lhar: gshegs bya gshegs byed dngos pos stong: 'on kyang snang tshul ye shes pa: skye med klong du badz+ra mu: nyer bsdu ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bdag gi thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros// snod bcud 'od zhu gzhal yas lhar thim zhing*// 'khor rnams gtso bo de yang dwangs ma'i srog /hūm̐ yig la thim gyen rdzogs nā da'i bar// mi dmigs ngang gyur slar yang skad cig gis// snang stong sgyu ma khro rgyal sku ru gyur// oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom ste// kun bzang 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sa brnyes nas// rang don mthar phyin mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// phan dang bde ba'i dpal la 'god par shog

/'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa der// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// bkra shis brjod pa ni/ mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal zhi khro yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yi// bkra shis phyogs dus kun tu khyab par shog / ces sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// //'di ni tshul 'di lha gzhung gzhan dang mi sbrel tshe tshogs mchod sogs rjes rim smin lugs gshin rje dregs 'joms las blang yang chog par gsungs shing*/ sngon chings zur byang yang de las blangs mdzad pa ltar lag len 'jug pa bde khyad de las zur bton byas pa'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun ni smin gter gshin rje dregs 'joms thob pas chog pa'o//
